features.title: Colorful icons
features.description: Give Wino a splash of color. Folders, flags, calendar views and reminders get a soft tint, so you can spot them at a glance. Turn it on in Settings > Personalization > Icon style.

features.title: See what's new
features.description: Never miss an improvement. After an update, look for the megaphone in the title bar to see what changed. You can open these notes again at any time from Settings > About.
